correctness.rationale: Cyclic rotations are distinct by unique maximal zero gap. For each t, rotations 0^t1 index exactly gaps g_j>=t, sorting by the unique following circular gap g_{j+1}; this fixes each BWT letter as 1 iff t=g_j. Descending t-buckets and the separate one-starting rows yield zero counts d_k-1, (k-j+1)d_j, k*d1 and a final zero. Direct independent BWT sorting passes 21,840 exhaustive difference vectors and 17 radix-prefix cases. Counts match the word length and ones; no finite test is substituted for the proof.
